selection.criterion: EMA of source mean raw-logit validation CE plus target mean raw-logit validation CE

notes: This is a new paper-aligned recipe, not a copy of historical refined result-generating fits.
The manuscript does not numerically specify lambda_tgt, lambda_mmd or lambda_anchor; explicit defaults 1,2,2 are retained from the original base-training recipe.
Global MMD uses L2-normalized pre-head source versus hidden-label target inputs only.
Anchor prototype alignment uses raw 256D pre-head features and revealed target anchors only.
CNN and non-adapted CNN-SNGP use source plus target-anchor CE only, with exactly the same partitions and anchors.
Continual learning has its own preserved configuration and is not changed by this fixed-model recipe.
